name: Original rich profile SQL regression suite
Admin can upload a cover before activating Rich Profile
Second add is rejected and original cover survives
Replacement at the one-cover limit is atomic and returns the old path
Invalid replacement payload rolls back without touching current cover
Unknown ID and other vendor's cover cannot be replaced
Replacing a non-cover media ID is rejected
Inactive vendor and buyer cannot replace covers
Approved owner can replace cover after activation
Replacement racing after deletion fails without recreating the cover
Anonymous/authenticated roles cannot execute the write RPC
